title: Fixed single-complex tensor coefficient morphism
statement: For schemes [def-pc-scheme] A, B and X, maps q:A→X, q1:B→X and a:B→A with aq=q1, an O_X-module L [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and the shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], set M=q tensor-pullback L and N=q1 tensor-pullback L. Let d:a ordinary-pullback M≅N be the fixed coefficient identification [def-sc-tensor-coefficient-comparison]. Define e:La*(M[0])→N[0] as the canonical single-pullback map [lem-pc-canonical-single-pullback-comparison] followed by single(d.hom). This is an explicit morphism, with no inversion of the single-pullback map. Its defining equation is proved by reflexivity, so identity arrows, zero modules and empty schemes are included without additional assumptions.

def tensorSingleCoefficientMap {A B X : Scheme.{v}}
    (q : A ⟶ X) (q1 : B ⟶ X) (a : B ⟶ A) (h : a ≫ q = q1)
    (L : X.Modules) :
    (derivedPullback a).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings A.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q).obj L)) ⟶
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings B.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q1).obj L)
